entities.name: YbeY endoribonuclease
observations: The 154-residue query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q2GIJ7 from Anaplasma phagocytophilum.
YbeY is a single-strand-specific metallo-endoribonuclease involved in late-stage 70S ribosome quality control and maturation of the 3-prime terminus of 16S rRNA.
Reviewed homologs annotate one bound Zn2+ ion and cytoplasmic localization.
The query contains Pfam YbeY domain PF02130.25 at positions 20-143 with i-Evalue 1.3e-30.

source_tools.relevance: Exact sequence match, function, zinc cofactor, localization, GO terms, and Pfam domain

entities.name: YbeY sequence properties
observations: The query is 154 amino acids long with predicted molecular mass 17,889.439 Da, theoretical pI 5.972, and estimated charge at pH 7 of -4.6975.
The sequence-derived GRAVY is -0.124 and instability index is 37.898; these are computational estimates for the unmodified protein.

entities.name: 16S rRNA maturation
observations: YbeY participates in bacterial 16S rRNA 3-prime-end maturation and late-stage ribosome quality control.

source_tools.relevance: Curated homolog functional annotation and GO process

entities.name: Zinc ion
observations: Reviewed YbeY homologs are annotated to bind one Zn2+ ion; the annotation supports a zinc-dependent metallo-endoribonuclease role.
